alternative_explanations: Visible return chains may make reverse-pair reconstruction sufficient without executing a reusable online pushdown state update, while PPM, CTW or Re-Pair may match completion at lower full cost.
confounds: V13 reuses the locally visible v12 Python corpus and the same seven-symbol grammar; three byte permutations test equivariance and stability but are not independent task-family transfer.
falsification_criteria: Discard and make dormant this exact seven-symbol exhaustive grammar-search, point-mass, reset and pushdown family without tuning if the main is below exact_span_accuracy 1.0 in any seed/K/depth cell, lacks a 0.25 exact-span margin with lower bits over either source-identical ablation or the strongest complete implementable control at any seed/depth, exceeds the state budget, has missing cost accounting, any mandatory control is incomplete, or the main is implementably Pareto-dominated.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any frozen corpus mismatch or overlap between whole-file train, validation and test roles.
Invalidate unless training traces have maximum delimiter depth two and held-out scoring traces have exact depths three, four and five.
Invalidate if an implementable role receives source paths, unpermuted delimiters, token kinds or hand-written opener/closer identities.
Invalidate unless all pushdown roles share code and constants and differ only in learned stack state, bounded finite state or frozen transition learning.
Invalidate if a public query exposes any masked target, another test slot, or an evaluator-private delimiter identity.
Invalidate on post-score tuning, seed leakage, byte-permutation leakage or evaluator-integrity change.

outcome_policy.negative: Make this exact observation-induced pushdown family dormant without tuning, further benchmark repair or another variant, and return breadth allocation to a fundamentally different learned mechanism.
outcome_policy.null: Call the experiment inconclusive only for a recorded infrastructure, integrity or mandatory-control failure before a complete comparison; preserve all artifacts and do not treat partial scores as evidence.
outcome_policy.positive: Keep HYP-0050 only as narrow replicated adversarial screening evidence, do not promote or tune, and move breadth exploration to a fundamentally different mechanism unless an independent non-synthetic corpus is justified.

predicted_outcome: Across all three runner-realized seeds and every K=8/32, D=3/4/5 cell, learned_pushdown_masked_byte will achieve exact_span_accuracy 1.0, exceed each source-identical ablation and the strongest complete implementable control by at least 0.25 exact-span accuracy with lower bits_per_byte, remain within 4194304 state bytes, and be implementably Pareto non-dominated.
promotion_criteria: This locally visible adversarial screen cannot promote. A complete positive may only preserve narrow evidence and motivate an independent non-synthetic corpus using an unchanged mechanism.
research_question: Does the unchanged symbol-equivariant learner recover all simultaneously masked inner pushes from intact return chains on v13 across three runner-random permutations, while retaining the frozen causal margins and implementable Pareto non-dominance at full cost?
title: Observation-induced pushdown recoverable-push adversarial screen
